ORDER DENYING MOTION TO RECOGNIZE FOREIGN COUNTRY MONEY JUDGMENT

LAW AND MOTION 301, PETITIONERS AMOS HOREV AND YORAM BENAMI'S MOTION TO RECOGNIZE FOREIGN COUNTRY MONEY JUDGMENT WAS TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION. JUDGE: ERNEST H. GOLDSMITH; REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR #8189 ------------------------------- AFTER HEARING THE COURT RULED AS FOLLOWS: DENIED. ENFORCEMENT OF A FOREIGN MONEY JUDGMENT MAY ONLY BE SOUGHT BY CIVIL ACTION, NOT A PETITION. SEE CCP 1718; MANCO CONTRACTING CO. V. BEZDIKIAN (2008) 45 CAL. 4TH 192; AND RENOIR V. REDSTAR CORP. (2004) 123 CAL. APP. 4TH 1145. ORDER SIGNED. PARTIES NOTIFIED OF THE COURT'S RULING BY TELEPHONE.
